properties.description:
- Use one pure owner-predicate model whose changing inputs come from tracked engine reads; external changes enter validated transactions.
- Revalidate affected existing edges against candidate state; reject invalid changes without altering caches, committed state or observer events.
- Cover missing reads, enumeration, branch changes and disposal; TypeScript checks contracts while tests/review establish predicate purity.
- Replace both runtime graph node types and semantic-model kind classification; migrate actual stored/transported components, not only editor presentation.
properties.title: Resolve predicate invalidation and atomic edge constraints
